title: Requires a person that advertises, solicits, markets, sells or offers a health care cost sharing arrangement in this state or enters into a health care cost sharing arrangement with a resident must register with the Director of the Department of Consumer and Business Services.
headline: HB 2268 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2268 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
